create.name: Sonoma Mountain Zen Center
create.bio:
High on a mountain near Santa Rosa, Sonoma Mountain Zen Center is a temple of the Soto school of Zen in northern California, founded in 1973 by Jakusho Kwong-roshi to carry on the teaching of his own teacher, Shunryu Suzuki-roshi. Kwong-roshi, his wife Shinko and early students turned an old barn into the temple, Genjo-ji, and the centre's buildings are still largely made from reclaimed barn timber. After half a century as abbot he handed the role in 2023 to his son Nyoze Kwong, who trained at Eiheiji in Japan and is recognised by the Soto school as an international teacher. The centre also has affiliated groups in Poland and Iceland.

Practice centres on zazen, just sitting. A small resident community keeps a traditional daily round of early-morning and evening meditation and services, which anyone may join on site or over Zoom. On most Saturdays newcomers can receive meditation instruction before a period of sitting, a talk and a shared vegetarian lunch. The temple also runs monthly sesshin, seasonal practice periods, study groups, overnight temple stays and longer guest and residential training. Talks from sesshin and the Saturday programme are posted on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Saturday Community
courses.description: A Saturday-morning programme open to the public, on site or on Zoom: zazen, a Dharma talk and, on site, a vegetarian lunch. Newcomers can first join a meditation instruction session on most Saturdays.

courses.title: Temple Stay
courses.description: An overnight stay, offered on most Fridays, for beginners to take part in temple life: meditation and oryoki instruction, sitting periods, services and communal meals, with time for walking on the mountain.
courses.price: $150 per night (dormitory room, shared restroom); $175 per night (private room, shared restroom); $200 per night (private room with restroom)

courses.title: Guest Practice Stay and Personal Retreat
courses.description: Longer stays for those wanting to deepen practice: guests either follow the full resident schedule, including work practice, or make a personal retreat at their own pace. A path into resident training is also described.
courses.price: Guest Practice Stay: Rustic - $85/day; Economy - $125/day; Premium* - $140/day; Luxury* - $160/day. Personal or Solo Retreat: Rustic - $150/day; Economy - $165/day; Premium* - $175/day; Luxury* - $200/day

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Monthly or yearly membership for those who practise with the sangha regularly, with discounts on sesshin, events, study groups and stays according to level.
courses.price: $21 monthly or $252 annually; $42 monthly or $504 annually; $63+ monthly or $756+ annually

free_resources.title: Online zendo: daily zazen on Zoom
free_resources.description: The temple's morning and evening meditation periods, with walking meditation and chanting, are open online from Monday to Saturday. Chant texts can be downloaded so remote sitters can join the service.

free_resources.title: Resources: sutras and reading
free_resources.description: The texts chanted in the temple's services, a suggested reading list and audio, gathered on one page for students practising at home.
